Maneuvering

วงจรฟีดแบ็กการบังคับเลี้ยว

A control system that continually monitors rudder position and vessel heading to automatically correct steering and maintain set course.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

A control system that continually monitors rudder position and vessel heading to automatically correct steering and maintain set course.

Operational example

Steering feedback loop is active; monitor heading and adjust manual override only if deviation exceeds safe limits.
